row: College of Medicine - University of Saskatchewan

The College of Medicine at the University of Saskatchewan was established in 1926 and is located in Saskatoon.

We serve the people of Saskatchewan by producing outstanding clinical practitioners, generating new knowledge and facilitating improved patient outcomes, and are a leader in Indigenous health programs, education, and services, with a multitude of opportunities to learn about Indigenous health, culture, and community.
